description: Post a comment on a document, optionally anchored to specific text. Can also reply to an existing comment. If the document is in this MCP server's local store, 'key' is optional.

anchor_text.description: Text in the document this comment refers to

key.description: Comment, edit, or admin key. Optional if the document is in this MCP server's local store.

parent_id.description: ID of the comment to reply to (one level nesting)

name: post_comment
